notes: Maintainer rebuild (release examples): the first-pass scene had a 2-slot holder; Stage 1 says three slots, so the holder was rebuilt with n_slots 3 (springs alternating +x/-x/+x like a series holder), walls 1.0 mm and dividers 0.8 mm so three AAA slots fit the measured 38 mm footprint width; placement refit with fit_object_placement (x, y, yaw; IoU 0.78 through video_cam without the omitted leads). The battery kept its first-pass size and placement.

The spring-coil limit time constant: common/spring.py wrote solreflimit 0.0005 s on every coil joint, below MuJoCo's 2 x timestep floor (0.004 s) that the engine silently runs instead (solver_parameter_sanity_check failed the first-pass scene); the library now writes 2 x timestep (commit c5b659c) and the rebuilt asset and scene carry 0.004 s; every mechanism test was re-run with it (battery_seat_test in all three slots, articulated_joint_travel_test).

Naming: the holder is attached under the prefix 'holder_' (bodies holder_battery_holder*), so the battery object's '<id>_' prefix 'battery_' matches only the cell (battery_battery) and no holder body; the holder id still resolves to its root (the one body ending in '_battery_holder'). Stage 1 ids are unchanged.

Camera: register_table_camera(source='setup'); camera_check.png grid lies on the cloth and converges with the table edges. Frame 0 has a green exposure cast; colours were measured on source frame 45 (1.5 s, settled exposure, no hands) with the frame-0 masks (objects do not move before 2 s).

SIZE DEVIATION FROM STAGE 1: Stage 1 names the cell 'AA'. Built at AA size the renders were larger than the video on every side (first pass: IoU 0.66 holder, 0.40 battery; uniform-scale fits 0.82 / 0.64); the AAA standard cell (10.5 x 44.5 mm) matches those ratios, so cell and holder are built from the AAA size.

Battery initial state: Stage 1 says 'lying on the cloth'; the video shows the cell standing on its flat end before the pick (1.5 s, copper end up), so it is built upright (construct_battery upright=true).

Holder density 3000 kg/m^3 (23.5 g with three slots): lighter free housings jiggle under the spring and battery_seat_test's seated drift exceeds its 1 mm limit (first pass: 1.0-1.1 mm at 1250-2000 kg/m^3). Spring stiffness 200 N/m (a soft AAA contact).
Slot numbering: slot 0 is the asset's smallest local y; joints holder_battery_holder_s{0,1,2}spring_c1.
The battery's silhouette IoU (0.58 through video_cam) is limited by its size in the frame: ~10 x 25 px.
The holder's lead wires are omitted (with_wires false): rigid visual leads lying on the cloth sank into the tabletop whenever the free holder tilted in Stage 3; they take no part in the task.
scene_qc warns that the holder is at the edge of the left arm's reach (y 0.37 m); the video has it there. Stage 3 may move the stations with place_arm_stations.
